name: Image Generation — OpenAI
author: hearth-team
description: Generate and edit images with your preferred OpenAI image model (default gpt-image-2). Supports image-to-image and inpainting; transparent backgrounds require a compatible model. Configure a preferred model and optional fallback under skill settings. Saves results and the actual model used to Collateral. AI Image Family sub-skills route here by default.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

vault_inputs.label: Preferred image model
vault_inputs.help: Shared by OpenAI image generation and cat/dog selfies. Blank uses gpt-image-2. Refresh lists supported models available to your key; it does not generate images. Save configuration to apply.

vault_inputs.label: Fallback image model (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Blank disables fallback. Used only when the preferred model is unavailable or incompatible with transparency. No retry for quota, authentication, moderation or network errors. Pricing depends on the model used.
